read: k is how much of the model's gap from the closing line has held up in results, relearned from every completed game each run. 0 means the market already prices everything these stats know, so a stats gap alone is not an edge. kRaw below 0 means the market was right more often than the stats when they disagreed. bigGap shows how the stats side did when it disagreed with the close by 6 or more. Use k as given. While k is near 0, edges come from what the stats cannot see: news, timing, weather.
